items.text: The NIFTY 500 fell 0.6% on 27 Nov. Capital Goods was the strongest sector (+1.2%) and Forest Materials the weakest (−0.0%).

FIIs bought a net ₹1,634 Cr and DIIs sold a net ₹556 Cr of Indian shares on 27 Nov. Foreign investors are quietly accumulating in 68 niches. Heavy delivery buying this week in Travel Services & Railways Catering, Newspapers & Publishing and Construction & Earthmoving Equipment.
